helloWorld: ORMN Snippets: IntelliSense for ORMN (Google Sheets ORM) active.

openDb.docs:
Opens a Google Spreadsheet as an ORMN database.

`options`:
- `includeSpreadsheetMeta` (true)
- `includeSheetMeta` (true)
- `includeRowIndex` (true)
- `enableDelete` (true)
- `enableDeleteMany` (true)
- `enableDeleteAll` (true)
- `enableSave` (true)

_getTables.docs: Discovers and returns all sheets as tables with injected methods

_headers.docs: Column names (first row of the sheet)

_lastRow.docs: Last registered row in the table

_find.docs: Searches for a record by its ID (case-insensitive)

_firstBy.firma: (col: string, val: any, opts?: { caseInsensitive?: boolean }) => object | null
_firstBy.docs: First row matching the column value

_findManyBy.firma: (col: string, val: any, opts?: { caseInsensitive?: boolean }) => { data: object[], _delete() }
_findManyBy.docs: All rows matching the column value

_firstByQuery.docs:
First match using a JS expression. Use `{}` as row placeholder.

E.g.: `{}.Value > 1000`

_findManyByQuery.docs:
All matches using a JS expression. Use `{}` as row placeholder.

E.g.: `{}.Status === "income"`

_exist.firma: (col: string, val: any, opts?: { caseInsensitive?: boolean }) => boolean
_exist.docs: Checks if at least one record exists with that value

_create.docs:
Inserts a new row. Auto-generates headers if missing.

Returns the object with `_save()`, `_delete()` and `_rowIndex`.

_createMany.docs: Inserts multiple rows at once. Returns result with `_delete()` to undo.

_deleteAll.docs: Deletes all records from the table (keeps headers). CAREFUL!

_save.docs: Persists changes to the row in the sheet. Modify properties and call `_save()`.

_delete.docs: Deletes this row from the sheet
Deletes all rows from the search or batch result
